display.purpose: Page titles only (20px semibold Geist, tracking −0.01em).

label.purpose: 11px uppercase 0.14em micro-labels (.label-cap) above metrics and columns.

chip.purpose: 12px medium pill text for status chips and state labels.

data.purpose: Mono tabular for URLs, timestamps, table numbers.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme floating layers: command palette, popovers, tooltips, dialogs. Light theme swaps to 0 16px 40px -12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.18).

shadows.name: glass-blur
shadows.purpose: Shell surfaces only (sidebar, header, mobile sheet). Never behind data.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus-visible treatment; buttons add a 3px ring at 50% alpha.

motion.name: ease-spring-ring
motion.purpose: ring-pulse keyframe (1.8s loop) and soft expansions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: card-hover border/background shift; no lift, no shadow.

motion.name: boot-hold
motion.purpose: Session-once boot curtain timeline (GSAP); click skips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single commit action (Add monitor, Save). Emerald fill, dark-green text.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14"/><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg>Add monitor</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:10px; border:none; background:#10b981; color:#022c22; font:500 14px/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #10b981; outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(16 185 129 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions and pagination (Previous/Next, Export CSV).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:#e2e8f0; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); font:500 14px/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:rgb(148 163 184 / 0.12); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #10b981; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Header icon actions (⌘K search, theme, collapse). Muted icon, chrome-only.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:#94a3b8; border:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgb(148 163 184 / 0.12); color:#e2e8f0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #10b981; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input / Search Field
components.description: Translucent field on the dark ground; emerald border + ring on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Filter by name or URL" />
components.css: .ds-input { height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:rgb(15 23 42 / 0.58); color:#e2e8f0; border:1px solid rgb(148 163 184 / 0.28); font:400 14px/1.5 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; width:100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#10b981; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(16 185 129 / 0.35); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Hairline-first surface. Never rests on a shadow; hover brightens the border toward emerald.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius:12px; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); background:rgb(15 23 42 / 0.58); color:#e2e8f0; padding:16px; transition:border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, #10b981 32%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)); } .ds-label-cap { font:500 11px/1.4 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#94a3b8; margin:0; } .ds-card-value { font:600 24px/1.2 "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; margin:6px 0 0; } .ds-card-hint { font:400 12px/1.4 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#94a3b8; margin:4px 0 0; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar row; active state adds emerald tint plus a 2px left bar (never color alone).
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:10px; color:rgb(203 213 225 / 0.7); text-decoration:none; font:500 14px/1 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgb(148 163 184 / 0.12); color:#f1f5f9; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background:rgb(148 163 184 / 0.12); color:#f1f5f9; } .ds-nav-item.is-active::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:-8px; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:2px; border-radius:2px; background:#10b981; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #10b981; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Full-pill check state with a pulsing dot; tone comes from the status token only.
components.css: @keyframes ds-ring-pulse { 0% { box-shadow:0 0 0 0 currentColor; opacity:0.45; } 70% { box-shadow:0 0 0 5px transparent; opacity:0; } 100% { box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent; opacity:0; } } .ds-status-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); background:rgb(30 41 59 / 0.55); font:500 12px/1.4 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { position:relative; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:currentColor; } .ds-status-pill--up { color:#10b981; } .ds-status-pill--down { color:#fb7185; } .ds-status-pill--degraded { color:#fbbf24; } .ds-status-pill--unknown { color:#94a3b8; } .ds-status-pill--up .ds-status-dot, .ds-status-pill--down .ds-status-dot { animation:ds-ring-pulse 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; }

components.name: Label Cap
components.description: The 11px uppercase micro-label that opens every metric and column group.
components.css: .ds-label-cap { font:500 11px/1.4 "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#94a3b8; }

components.name: Uptime Strip
components.description: Signature 24-slot hourly strip. Muted slots mean no checks — silence is never colored.
components.css: .ds-strip { display:flex; gap:2px; align-items:stretch; height:44px; } .ds-strip i { flex:1 1 0; border-radius:4px; } .ds-strip .s-up { background:#10b981; } .ds-strip .s-warn { background:#fbbf24; } .ds-strip .s-down { background:#fb7185; } .ds-strip .s-none { background:rgb(30 41 59 / 0.85); border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); }

narrative.overview:
PulseWatch looks like an operator's console kept at 3am: a layered midnight ground with slow ambient light, glass chrome that holds still, and instruments that tell the truth. The intensity contract is "data calm, chrome loud" — the shell (rails, backdrop wash, boot sequence, empty states) is allowed atmosphere and glow, while tables, charts, and metrics stay quiet, dense, and monospace-precise. Saturation is earned only by state: emerald means up, rose means down, amber means degraded; everything else is slate.

The system rejects both marketing gloss and raw utilitarian gray. It is cyberpunk-infused through material (layered dark gradients, hairline glass, a slow aurora wash, a wireframe-orb boot) rather than through neon overload — the brief's pinned direction, applied with restraint. Light theme is a first-class remap of the same roles on cool paper, not an afterthought. Depth is declared once: cards declare elevation with a hairline border, floating layers declare it with a soft offset shadow, and nothing doubles up.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-first elevation: borders carry structure; `shadow-pop` is reserved for floating layers only.
Status palette as the only loud color; chrome stays monochrome slate/emerald accents.
Geist + Geist Mono with tabular numerals everywhere numbers live.
Instrument density: 11px uppercase micro-labels, 12px radii, 16–24px rhythm.
One signature ambient layer (canvas aurora) + one signature data component (the padded uptime strip).

rules.name: The Status-Voice Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only where it carries check state (up/degraded/down/unknown) or the single primary action. If a screen has three colors, two of them are probably lying.

rules.name: The Chrome-Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Gradients, aurora, and blur belong to the shell layer (body, sidebar, header, overlays, boot) — never behind a data table or chart. Data areas sit on flat card surfaces.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change in place — metrics, table columns, durations — renders with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Jittering digits read as unreliable data.

rules.name: The Declare-Elevation-Once Rule
rules.body: Cards get a border and never a shadow; floating layers get `shadow-pop` and never a border-as-lift. Mixing both on one surface is banned — it is how dashboards start looking like sticker books.

dos: Do keep resting surfaces shadow-free — hairline border + translucent fill declare elevation.
Do reserve saturated emerald/rose/amber for check state and the single primary action.
Do render every mutable number with tabular numerals (`.tabular`, mono, `font-variant-numeric`).
Do pad uptime/history series to their full window with explicit "no checks" slots.
Do show long report tables paginated at 20 rows with a count footer.
Do keep `.label-cap` at 11px/0.14em uppercase, 3–4 words maximum.
Do use `shadow-pop` on floating layers (palette, popovers, tooltips, dialogs).
donts: Don't put a drop shadow on a card, or a hairline-lift on a floating layer — pick one elevation language per surface.
Don't use blur/glass behind data tables or charts; atmosphere belongs to the shell.
Don't introduce chart colors outside the token set (emerald, sky, amber, violet, rose are the whole alphabet).
Don't animate digits in a way that reflows their box, or drop `tabular-nums` from live numbers.
Don't use status hues as decorative accents, hover colors, or section backgrounds.
Don't show raw enum values (states, UUIDs) where labeled words belong — breadcrumb "Monitor", pill "Open".
